Q-matrix from a knowledge graph

Source: R/kg-models.R
mv_kg_qmatrix.Rd

Returns the item-by-concept Q-matrix stored in a knowledge graph: A 1 where an item measures a concept, else 0. Weights given to the measures edges are kept.

Usage

mv_kg_qmatrix(kg, items = NULL, drop_empty = FALSE)

Arguments

kg

a knowledge graph from mv_kg_build() or as_mv_kg().

items

optional item names (or a data frame whose column names are used) to set the order of the rows; columns of a data frame that are not items of the graph, such as an ID column, are skipped.

drop_empty

logical; drop concepts that no item measures.

Value

A numeric matrix with one row per item and one column per concept.

See also

mv_kg_model() and mv_kg_irt() to fit the matching mirt model; mv_kg_hierarchy() for the mastery patterns the prerequisites allow.

Examples

mv_kg_qmatrix(fractions_kg)
#>     meaning equivalent mixed compare common_denominator add_subtract
#> F01       1          0     0       0                  0            0
#> F02       1          0     0       0                  0            0
#> F03       1          0     0       0                  0            0
#> F04       1          0     0       0                  0            0
#> F05       0          1     0       0                  0            0
#> F06       0          1     0       0                  0            0
#> F07       0          1     0       0                  0            0
#> F08       0          1     0       0                  0            0
#> F09       0          0     1       0                  0            0
#> F10       0          0     1       0                  0            0
#> F11       0          0     1       0                  0            0
#> F12       0          0     1       0                  0            0
#> F13       0          0     0       1                  0            0
#> F14       0          0     0       1                  0            0
#> F15       0          0     0       1                  0            0
#> F16       0          0     0       1                  0            0
#> F17       0          0     0       0                  1            0
#> F18       0          0     0       0                  1            0

#> F23       0          0     1       0                  0            1
